name: agent-studio
description: Agent Studio —— 基于 DeepSeek Harness 的受限 Agent 平台（Gateway + Vue 管理端 + Cordis 权限插件）

scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build:plugins && npm run build:gateway && npm run build:web
scripts.build:plugins: npm run build -w @agent-studio/plugin-agent-policy && npm run build -w @agent-studio/plugin-agent-tools && npm run build -w @agent-studio/plugin-agent-audit
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @agent-studio/shared && npm run typecheck -w @agent-studio/plugin-agent-policy && npm run typecheck -w @agent-studio/plugin-agent-tools && npm run typecheck -w @agent-studio/plugin-agent-audit && npm run typecheck -w @agent-studio/gateway && npm run typecheck -w @agent-studio/web
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run smoke && npm run e2e
